input.title: Use singular "recipient" when a report has one recipient
input.body:
File: src/report.tsx

In ReportLine, the <small> text always reads "{n} recipients". When report.deliveredTo.length is 1 it should read "1 recipient" (singular), with the plural kept for every other count, including 0. Choose the word from the same deliveredTo.length value so the count and word cannot disagree.

text: The bug is in `src/report.tsx`: it always prints "recipients" with no singular case. Labelling it as a bug and opening the pull request.

label: bug
file: src/report.tsx

ReportLine always renders "{count} recipients", so a report with one recipient shows "1 recipients". The fix belongs in this component: choose "recipient" when deliveredTo.length is 1. A draft pull request is open for it.

text:
I triaged issue-4624 (the "1 recipients" wording on the recent reports list).

- **Label:** `bug`
- **File:** `src/report.tsx`. `ReportLine` always renders "{count} recipients", so a single recipient shows "1 recipients".
- **Pull request:** draft PR `pr-26`, from branch `repomind/issue-4624`. It proposes choosing "recipient" when `deliveredTo.length` is 1.
- **Comment:** posted as `comment-31`, with the label and file lines first.

I did not run the test suite against the branch.
